workflow.name: OLEANDER Blender Professional FreeCAD Face Translate

authority_chain.kernel_route: TopoShape.replaceShape / BRepTools_ReShape with sewShape/fix/removeSplitter normalization and shell-to-solid rebuild when required
authority_chain.selector: unique +Z top planar face resolved from geometry rule; no FaceN persistence

bounded_scope: rectangular prismatic single-solid FreeCAD/OCCT B-Rep fixture
unique +Z top planar face selected by geometry rule and re-resolved after width rebuild
rigid selected-face in-plane X translation of +5 mm
rigid selected-face in-plane Y translation of -4 mm
rigid selected-face diagonal translation of +3 mm/+4 mm with 5 mm resultant
selected top face plus four adjacent faces replaced through BRepTools_ReShape while opposite bottom face remains untouched
R001 80x50x10 mm and R002 100x50x10 mm both produce valid one-solid six-face B-Rep results
height envelope preserved and volume preserved for bounded shear translations
FCStd plus X/Y/diagonal STEP artifacts saved and FCStd reopened with operation metadata intact
translation magnitude greater than 20 mm rejected before mutation
Blender receives only tessellated diagonal R002 display derivative and preserves source hashes/authority across .blend save/reopen
invalidation_rule: Invalidate this bounded validation if the FreeCAD/OCCT authoritative edit is replaced by mesh-only mutation, selector identity becomes raw FaceN persistence, source artifact hashes/authority no longer survive readback, or the bounded failure gates are removed.
authority_note: This receipt validates only a bounded planar top-face in-plane translation workflow. It narrows P0-B but does not promote P0-B or OLEANDER Blender to default professional parity.
